item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows quadrilateral $PQRS$ with both pairs of opposite sides parallel. Bina asks how rectangles and squares relate to parallelograms.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: $PQRS$ is a parallelogram; rectangles and squares are special parallelograms because their opposite sides are parallel.
options.B: $PQRS$ is a parallelogram only if all four angles are $90^{\circ}$.
options.D: The same rule classifies any open path of four segments as a parallelogram.
